remarks: Welcome to this beautifully designed 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo featuring the sought-after Lykke floor plan by StreetSide Developments. Offering approximately 565 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this modern unit showcases stylish vinyl plank flooring, quartz countertops throughout, stainless steel kitchen appliances, and contemporary two-tone cabinetry. The open-concept layout maximizes space and functionality, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere perfect for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors. Enjoy low-maintenance living in a vibrant community with convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, walking trails, and major commuter routes. An excellent opportunity to own a modern home with quality finishes and exceptional value. (id:67522)
